summary: REQ-1 and REQ-3 appear implemented (header branding removal and Forge token image shrink). REQ-2 is only partially evidenced: rounding was added on Preview, but the diff summary suggests rounding was applied more broadly than requested, which risks changing other NFT images. The diff also includes multiple broad UI/behavior changes not requested (dashboard/footer redesign, vault/worker logic, tailwind/css animation systems, etc.), and a project_state.json update despite the “UI-only” constraint.

missing_requirements.requirement: Apply rounded corners only to the main NFT preview image on the Preview page, without changing corner styling for other NFT images elsewhere in the app.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary indicates rounded corners were applied more broadly than just the main Preview canvas ("consistent rounded corners throughout"), so it’s not demonstrated that other NFT images (Vault grid, Forge tokens grid, etc.) were left unchanged as required.
